text: Hi Maya, I am calling because the train to Bristol has been cancelled.
ipa: /haɪ ˈmaɪə aɪm ˈkɔːlɪŋ bɪˈkɒz ðə treɪn tə ˈbrɪstəl həz bɪn ˈkænsəld/

text: Could we take the coach that leaves at half past nine instead?
ipa: /kəd wi teɪk ðə kəʊtʃ ðət liːvz ət hɑːf pɑːst naɪn ɪnˈsted/

text: That should work, but we will need to change at Reading.
ipa: /ðæt ʃəd wɜːk bət wiːl niːd tə tʃeɪndʒ ət ˈredɪŋ/

text: The connection is only fifteen minutes, so please keep your ticket ready.
ipa: /ðə kəˈnekʃən ɪz ˈəʊnli ˌfɪfˈtiːn ˈmɪnɪts səʊ pliːz kiːp jɔː ˈtɪkɪt ˈredi/

text: I have already booked two seats near the front of the coach.
ipa: /aɪv ɔːlˈredi bʊkt tuː siːts nɪə ðə frʌnt əv ðə kəʊtʃ/

text: Please send me the new booking reference when you receive it.
ipa: /pliːz send mi ðə njuː ˈbʊkɪŋ ˈrefrəns wen jə rɪˈsiːv ɪt/

text: I will message you immediately, and we can meet outside the main entrance.
ipa: /aɪl ˈmesɪdʒ ju ɪˈmiːdiətli ən wi kən miːt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə meɪn ˈentrəns/
